user.title: Connect to Flexit Bodø Supreme
user.description: The easiest way to find the IP address is to set a static/reserved IP for the fan in your router. The device ID (16 characters) and PIN (4 digits) are the same ones you use in the Flexit Fans app.

error.cannot_connect: Could not reach the fan. Check the IP address and that the fan is on the same network.
